metadata.title: Cisplatin, Lomustine and Vincristine (CLV) Therapy
metadata.indication: Adult high-risk medulloblastoma or other primitive neuro-ectodermal tumour (PNET).
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled; independent clinical/pharmacy review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: NCCP 00806 v2 and fresh lomustine/cisplatin product information reconciled; source gaps and conflicts remain explicit, not clinical authorisation.

source_conflicts.issue: Platelets 80 to < 100 with ANC ≥ 1 are unallocated by the NCCP initial/new-dose table; recovery after a hold still requires ≥ 100.
Fractional cisplatin CrCl 49–50 and 59–60 bands are not allocated.
Vincristine bilirubin fraction and neurotoxicity grading edition/recovery grade are not specified. Current linked HPRA vincristine PDF returned 404; no unverifiable product rule was substituted.
NCCP lomustine 80% original/new full dose differs from product WBC/prior-dose/nadir table; product platelet 24– < 25 overlap is unresolved.

Cisplatin 1 h/local hydration and renal dose bands differ from current Accord 6–8 h/hydration/diuresis and pre-existing renal contraindication. Actual product/local prescribing plan requires pharmacy reconciliation.
NCCP conditional PFT/audiology differs from additional product baseline/ongoing monitoring.
NCCP lomustine contraception 6 months both sexes differs from current commonSmPC 7 months women/4 months men; obtain product-specific advice.
NCCP cited outcome studies are paediatric; do not present them as adult CLV survival estimates.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Component-specific source decisions require current values, prior dose/nadir and the actual product. NCCP gaps and NCCP/SmPC conflicts remain explicit specialist reviews; no automatic cumulative reductions or restart dose is generated.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00806 Version 2. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Adult high-risk medulloblastoma or other primitive neuro-ectodermal tumour (PNET).

treatment.schedule_summary: Begin 4–6 weeks after craniospinal radiotherapy. Eight 42-day cycles: lomustine 75 mg/m² orally once on Day 1; cisplatin 75 mg/m² IV on Day 1 with local hydration; vincristine 1.5 mg/m² IV(max 2 mg) on Days 1,8,15. Confirm product-specific administration and all dose modifications.

components.note: Single oral dose; unlicensed supply; never repeat before 6 weeks. Review delayed nadir and lifetime exposure.
NCCP 1 h in 1000 mL NaCl 0.9% plus local pre/post hydration; current Accord SmPC 6–8 h differs. Pharmacy must reconcile actual product and local plan.
Maximum 2 mg; 50 mL IV-only minibag over 15 minutes under local vinca safeguards. No intrathecal administration.

hypersensitivity.label: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component

anc_x10e9_l.label: Current pre-dose absolute neutrophil count (not preceding nadir)

platelets_x10e9_l.label: Current pre-dose platelet count (not preceding nadir)

neuropathy_grade.label: Current clinician-verified neurotoxicity source grade
neuropathy_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not specify a grading edition or an exact recovery grade. Confirm a clinician-assigned source grade and documented recovery; do not silently convert to CTCAE v5/v6.
neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade 1: full scheduled vincristine if otherwise suitable; Grade 2: withhold until recovery then 50% dose; Grade 3–4: omit. Recovery and previous reduction require prescriber confirmation.

cisplatin_hydration_and_magnesium_ready.label: Cisplatin hydration and magnesium plan confirmed

pulmonary_symptoms_or_concern.label: New pulmonary symptoms or concern for lomustine pulmonary toxicity

high_risk_medulloblastoma_or_pnet_confir.label: Consultant confirms adult high-risk medulloblastoma / PNET indication
high_risk_medulloblastoma_or_pnet_confir.assessment_guidance: This is a diagnosis and risk classification, not a toxicity grade. NCCP examples are not a complete risk algorithm; confirm diagnosis and multidisciplinary plan.

weeks_since_craniospinal_rt.label: Weeks since completion of craniospinal radiotherapy before Cycle 1

crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance (CrCl), exact result
crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Use measured or locally validated calculated CrCl, not unadjusted eGFR. Preserve decimal values. NCCP cisplatin bands leave 49–50 and 59–60 gaps; seek review rather than round.

severe_renal_impairment.label: Severe renal impairment, clinician assessed (NCCP exclusion)

hepatic_impairment.label: Liver impairment severity (clinician assessed)
hepatic_impairment.assessment_guidance: NCCP does not define a numeric threshold for severe impairment. Do not infer severity from bilirubin alone.

bilirubin_fraction.label: Bilirubin fraction reported
bilirubin_fraction.assessment_guidance: The NCCP vincristine table does not identify total versus direct bilirubin; confirm the applicable product and local interpretation before a numerical dose.

prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.label: Highest prior vincristine neurotoxicity source grade requiring modification
prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.source_grading_note: The NCCP table does not specify a grading edition or an exact recovery grade. Confirm a clinician-assigned source grade and documented recovery; do not silently convert to CTCAE v5/v6.
prior_vincristine_neurotoxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade 1: full scheduled vincristine if otherwise suitable; Grade 2: withhold until recovery then 50% dose; Grade 3–4: omit. Recovery and previous reduction require prescriber confirmation.

vincristine_neurotoxicity_recovery_confi.label: Prescriber confirms recovery from prior Grade 2 neurotoxicity

vincristine_prior_reduction_or_omission.label: Vincristine previously reduced or omitted (retain dose history)

vincristine_iv_minibag_verified.label: Vincristine IV-only minibag and route safeguards verified

severe_constipation_or_ileus.label: Severe constipation, abdominal distension or possible ileus

bowel_prophylaxis_plan_confirmed.label: Constipation prevention and monitoring plan confirmed

aprepitant_or_azole_exposure.label: Aprepitant or azole antifungal exposure requiring vincristine interaction review

interaction_review_needed.label: Unresolved interaction / overlapping neuro-, renal- or marrow toxicity

antiemetic_plan_confirmed.label: Day 1 antiemetic plan confirmed after vincristine interaction review

baseline_tests_complete.label: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile and indicated hearing/PFT assessments reviewed

scheduled_tests_complete.label: Current FBC, renal/liver/electrolytes and indicated hearing/PFT monitoring reviewed

weekly_counts_plan_confirmed.label: Weekly blood-count plan for at least 6 weeks after lomustine confirmed

lomustine_supply_and_single_dose_verifie.label: Unlicensed lomustine supply and single Day 1 dose instructions verified

lomustine_days_since_previous_dose.label: Days since previous lomustine dose (repeat-course assessment)

lomustine_prior_count_delay.label: A previous lomustine count delay requires recovery / new baseline-dose review

lomustine_dose_history_confirmed.label: Original, previous and new baseline lomustine doses reconciled with pharmacy

lomustine_prior_reduction.label: Previous lomustine dose reduction (do not automatically re-escalate)

lomustine_nadir_review_complete.label: Prior-cycle nadir and delayed blood counts reviewed before repeat lomustine

wbc_nadir_x10e9_l.label: Lowest WBC in preceding cycle (not ANC)

wbc_x10e9_l.label: Current total white cell count (not ANC)

projected_lomustine_cumulative_mg_m2.label: Pharmacy-verified lifetime lomustine total INCLUDING proposed next dose

lomustine_cumulative_history_confirmed.label: All prior lomustine exposure and proposed-dose total reconciled

wheat_allergy.label: Wheat allergy (lomustine medac contains wheat starch)

prior_nitrosourea_nonresponse.label: Previous tumour nonresponse to another nitrosourea

live_vaccine_exposure.label: Planned/current live vaccine during immunosuppressive treatment

new_hearing_symptoms.label: New tinnitus, hearing loss or vestibular symptoms

new_renal_or_electrolyte_abnormality.label: New clinically important renal dysfunction or electrolyte disturbance

cisplatin_product_and_local_plan_confirm.label: Pharmacy reconciled cisplatin product, infusion duration, hydration and any renal exception

preexisting_renal_impairment.label: Pre-existing renal impairment requiring cisplatin product contraindication review

antifungal_plan_confirmed.label: Local antifungal prophylaxis plan reviewed, avoiding vincristine/azole interaction

cisplatin_product_recovery_verified.label: Product-specific cisplatin repeat-course blood, renal/urea and hearing criteria reconciled

action.message: A prior count delay remains unresolved until BOTH ANC ≥ 1 and platelets ≥ 100. Do not apply the 80% restart to an unrecovered count.

action.message: Counts meet the NCCP recovery targets. Reconcile 80% of the documented original lomustine dose as the new full dose, prior reductions, nadir, organ function and delay number. Do not automatically multiply a previously reduced dose or return to 75 mg/m².

action.message: More than two count delays requires the prescribing clinician to review the treatment plan.

rules.explanation: More than two count delays requires the prescribing clinician to review the treatment plan.

action.message: Retain the documented original, previous and new full lomustine doses; recovery does not authorise re-escalation. The NCCP 80% count-delay and 75% renal instructions must not be multiplied without a consultant/pharmacy decision.

rules.explanation: Retain the documented original, previous and new full lomustine doses; recovery does not authorise re-escalation. The NCCP 80% count-delay and 75% renal instructions must not be multiplied without a consultant/pharmacy decision.

action.message: Do not repeat lomustine before 42 days: marrow toxicity is delayed and cumulative. The NCCP regimen uses ONE oral Day 1 dose, not a daily course.

rules.explanation: Do not repeat lomustine before 42 days: marrow toxicity is delayed and cumulative. The NCCP regimen uses ONE oral Day 1 dose, not a daily course.

action.message: Before repeat lomustine confirm the interval, preceding nadir, all prior dose changes and lifetime cumulative exposure. Normal current counts alone are insufficient.

rules.explanation: Before repeat lomustine confirm the interval, preceding nadir, all prior dose changes and lifetime cumulative exposure. Normal current counts alone are insufficient.

action.message: Review preceding-cycle nadirs and delayed recovery before repeat lomustine; the current SmPC bases changes on previous response and is not identical to NCCP Table 1.

rules.explanation: Review preceding-cycle nadirs and delayed recovery before repeat lomustine; the current SmPC bases changes on previous response and is not identical to NCCP Table 1.

action.message: Prior nadir crosses a lomustine product dose-adjustment band even if present counts recovered. The SmPC uses WBC and prior dose, while NCCP uses ANC and original-dose 80% after a delay. Resolve the regimen/product differences; do not automatically calculate a percentage.

rules.explanation: Prior nadir crosses a lomustine product dose-adjustment band even if present counts recovered. The SmPC uses WBC and prior dose, while NCCP uses ANC and original-dose 80% after a delay. Resolve the regimen/product differences; do not automatically calculate a percentage.

action.message: The current common SmPC platelet nadir rows overlap from 24 to < 25×10⁹/L (70% row starts 24;50% row extends below 25). This is unresolved source ambiguity, not a numeric-dose calculation.

rules.explanation: The current common SmPC platelet nadir rows overlap from 24 to < 25×10⁹/L (70% row starts 24;50% row extends below 25). This is unresolved source ambiguity, not a numeric-dose calculation.

action.message: The lomustine SmPC requires current WBC ≥ 4 before repeating, while NCCP Table 1 uses ANC ≥ 1. WBC and ANC are distinct; resolve recovery and the product-specific plan before further lomustine.

rules.explanation: The lomustine SmPC requires current WBC ≥ 4 before repeating, while NCCP Table 1 uses ANC ≥ 1. WBC and ANC are distinct; resolve recovery and the product-specific plan before further lomustine.

action.message: Arrange weekly counts for at least six weeks after each lomustine dose, including the delayed nadir and any extended recovery.

rules.explanation: Arrange weekly counts for at least six weeks after each lomustine dose, including the delayed nadir and any extended recovery.

action.message: Verify unlicensed-drug supply with the dispensing pharmacy and ONE prescribed Day 1 lomustine dose. Do not repeat after vomiting or take extra doses without oncology advice.

rules.explanation: Verify unlicensed-drug supply with the dispensing pharmacy and ONE prescribed Day 1 lomustine dose. Do not repeat after vomiting or take extra doses without oncology advice.

action.message: The current lomustine SmPC maximum cumulative exposure is 1000 mg/m². The proposed lifetime total exceeds it: do not give the proposed lomustine dose; seek consultant/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: The current lomustine SmPC maximum cumulative exposure is 1000 mg/m². The proposed lifetime total exceeds it: do not give the proposed lomustine dose; seek consultant/pharmacy review.

action.message: Previous lifetime lomustine exposure has reached or exceeded 1000 mg/m². Further positive dosing would exceed the product maximum; seek consultant/pharmacy review.

rules.explanation: Previous lifetime lomustine exposure has reached or exceeded 1000 mg/m². Further positive dosing would exceed the product maximum; seek consultant/pharmacy review.

action.message: The proposed lifetime total reaches the 1000 mg/m² maximum exactly. Recheck all prior exposure, proposed dose and pulmonary risk; this is not automatic clearance for the final dose.

rules.explanation: The proposed lifetime total reaches the 1000 mg/m² maximum exactly. Recheck all prior exposure, proposed dose and pulmonary risk; this is not automatic clearance for the final dose.

action.message: Reconcile lifetime lomustine exposure including previous regimens and the proposed next dose before prescribing.

rules.explanation: Reconcile lifetime lomustine exposure including previous regimens and the proposed next dose before prescribing.

action.message: NCCP Table 2 specifies 75% of the original lomustine dose at CrCl 30–50 mL/min. Confirm dialysis status, original/current dose and any marrow reduction; do not combine reductions automatically.

rules.explanation: NCCP Table 2 specifies 75% of the original lomustine dose at CrCl 30–50 mL/min. Confirm dialysis status, original/current dose and any marrow reduction; do not combine reductions automatically.

action.message: Lomustine is not recommended by NCCP at CrCl < 30 mL/min or during haemodialysis. Withhold the proposed dose for specialist review; the separate severe-renal exclusion remains applicable.

rules.explanation: Lomustine is not recommended by NCCP at CrCl < 30 mL/min or during haemodialysis. Withhold the proposed dose for specialist review; the separate severe-renal exclusion remains applicable.

rules.explanation: NCCP does not recommend lomustine in severe hepatic impairment. No numeric definition of severe is supplied; obtain consultant/pharmacy review.

action.message: NCCP expects no hepatic dose adjustment for mild/moderate impairment, but abnormal liver tests, eligibility and other dose restrictions still require review.

rules.explanation: NCCP expects no hepatic dose adjustment for mild/moderate impairment, but abnormal liver tests, eligibility and other dose restrictions still require review.

action.message: NCCP specifies 50% of the original cisplatin dose at CrCl 40–49 mL/min. The current Accord SmPC contraindicates pre-existing renal impairment; reconcile the actual product and renal exception with the consultant/pharmacist before a dose. No automatic calculation.

rules.explanation: NCCP specifies 50% of the original cisplatin dose at CrCl 40–49 mL/min. The current Accord SmPC contraindicates pre-existing renal impairment; reconcile the actual product and renal exception with the consultant/pharmacist before a dose. No automatic calculation.

action.message: NCCP specifies 75% of the original cisplatin dose at CrCl 50–59 mL/min. The current Accord SmPC contraindicates pre-existing renal impairment; reconcile the actual product and renal exception with the consultant/pharmacist before a dose. No automatic calculation.

rules.explanation: The printed NCCP cisplatin bands leave fractional CrCl 49–50 and 59–60 mL/min unallocated. Do not round or select a percentage without specialist interpretation.

action.message: Cisplatin is not recommended by NCCP below CrCl 40 mL/min. Seek specialist review of eligibility and alternatives.

rules.explanation: Cisplatin is not recommended by NCCP below CrCl 40 mL/min. Seek specialist review of eligibility and alternatives.

action.message: NCCP says 50% of the original cisplatin dose may be considered during haemodialysis. This conditional exception needs specialist pharmacy/renal review of product contraindications, schedule and dialysis timing; no automatic dose.

rules.explanation: NCCP says 50% of the original cisplatin dose may be considered during haemodialysis. This conditional exception needs specialist pharmacy/renal review of product contraindications, schedule and dialysis timing; no automatic dose.

rules.explanation: Confirm haemodialysis status before interpreting the renal table; a reported CrCl alone does not establish the non-dialysis pathway.

rules.explanation: The current Accord cisplatin product contraindicates pre-existing renal impairment, while NCCP lists reduced-dose bands. Resolve the actual product and consultant-approved plan explicitly.

action.message: Reconcile the actual cisplatin product and local administration plan: NCCP lists a 1-hour infusion, whereas the current Accord SmPC describes 6–8 hours and different hydration/diuresis instructions. Do not generate a prescription from an unresolved source conflict.

rules.explanation: Reconcile the actual cisplatin product and local administration plan: NCCP lists a 1-hour infusion, whereas the current Accord SmPC describes 6–8 hours and different hydration/diuresis instructions. Do not generate a prescription from an unresolved source conflict.

rules.explanation: Confirm pre/post cisplatin hydration, magnesium/electrolytes, fluid status and urine-output plan under local policy before administration. NCCP does not recommend routine furosemide without fluid excess.

action.message: Investigate and correct clinically important renal/electrolyte abnormalities before further cisplatin; review cumulative nephrotoxicity and the individual hydration plan.

rules.explanation: Investigate and correct clinically important renal/electrolyte abnormalities before further cisplatin; review cumulative nephrotoxicity and the individual hydration plan.

rules.explanation: New tinnitus, hearing or balance change needs assessment and audiology before further cisplatin; significant hearing impairment/tinnitus is a separate NCCP regimen exclusion.

rules.explanation: Neurological toxicity also requires review of cisplatin, which can cause cumulative and irreversible neuropathy. The NCCP vincristine percentage is not a cisplatin reduction algorithm.

rules.explanation: NCCP specifies 50% of original vincristine when bilirubin is above 51μmol/L, but does not name the bilirubin fraction. Confirm fraction, actual product, previous dose/cap and concurrent neurotoxicity before a numerical dose.

rules.explanation: The elevated bilirubin result has no confirmed fraction. NCCP does not specify total versus direct; ask pharmacy to reconcile the laboratory value and current product instructions.

rules.explanation: Withhold vincristine for source Grade 2 neurotoxicity until recovery, then review the source 50% dose. NCCP does not specify an exact recovery grade or how to combine previous reductions; do not automatically restart.

rules.explanation: Review aprepitant/azole exposure before vincristine: CYP3A4 inhibition can increase neurotoxicity. NCCP advises avoiding azoles with vincristine; do not auto-generate aprepitant solely from cisplatin emetic risk.

action.message: Day 1 includes high-emetic-risk cisplatin and moderate-to-high oral lomustine. Confirm an individual antiemetic plan and vincristine interactions; Day 8/15 vincristine alone is minimally emetogenic.

rules.explanation: Day 1 includes high-emetic-risk cisplatin and moderate-to-high oral lomustine. Confirm an individual antiemetic plan and vincristine interactions; Day 8/15 vincristine alone is minimally emetogenic.

action.message: Review current medicines and product interactions, including anti-seizure agents, cimetidine/theophylline, nephrotoxic/ototoxic medicines and CYP3A4 inhibitors. Do not stop essential anti-seizure therapy automatically.

action.message: Assess new breathlessness/cough or suspected lomustine pulmonary toxicity before more lomustine; review cumulative exposure and pulmonary-function testing.

action.message: Baseline FVC or DLCO below 70% predicted identifies higher lomustine pulmonary risk in the product SmPC. It is a risk-review threshold, not an invented automatic DLCO < 60 stopping rule.

action.message: At exactly 130μmol/L the product wording differs: one repeat-course list uses ≤ 130, another says below 130. Resolve the boundary with pharmacy; do not silently select a permissive interpretation.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Current NCCP regimen emetogenic classification; regimen phase/component and local policy must be considered.
premedications: Cisplatin pre- and post-hydration with magnesium according to local policy.
other_supportive_care: Avoid azole antifungals with vincristine where possible; review CYP3A4 interactions.
Monitor audiology, renal function, electrolytes and pulmonary toxicity as clinically indicated.
